thread_text:
rita: quick heads-up — SDK 3.12.0-canary changed model-pin resolution for vision routes. saw a small routing mismatch on canary traffic. proposing a scoped runtime pin for tonight's change window (23:30 UTC) targeting model-family:vision-lite.

sam: can you paste the canary snippet?

rita: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-30T22:10:12Z WARN router: pin-resolution fallback for model=vision-lite-2.1 -> default-model
request_id: r-ccd4a1
sdk: 3.12.0-canary
runtime: 3.7.0
```

pm-chen: impact: a subset of Dedicated vision-lite customers may be routed to CPU-backed default models -> higher latency/cost. recommend scoped runtime pin of 3.6.8 for the cohort.

rita: plan: deploybot pin add --id vl-3033 --runtime runtime:3.6.8 --scope "model-family:vision-lite" --duration 3h --meta "reason:SDK3.12-pin-resolution-fallback" at 2026-03-30T23:30:00Z. monitor route-mismatch-count and p95 latency. rollback if route-mismatch >0.3% over 10m.

deploybot: scheduled action vl-3033 at 2026-03-30T23:30:00Z by rita.

deploybot: executed vl-3033 at 2026-03-30T23:30:05Z  runtime pinned runtime:3.6.8 to scope:model-family:vision-lite (vl-3033).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=route-mismatch-count(scope=vision-lite) > 0.3% over 10m -> page @oncall-eng-sre.

sam: initial telemetry shows route-mismatch dropped to 0.01% and p95 latency normalized. holding 30m watch.

rita: ops note: to remove use `deploybot pin remove --id vl-3033`. to rollback to runtime 3.7.0 use `deploybot rollback --id vl-3033 --target runtime:3.7.0`. prefer pin remove after SDK patch.

pm-chen: drafting short relnote and customer note for affected Dedicated customers.

rita: after 2.5h stable we lifted the pin at 02:00 UTC. `deploybot pin remove --id vl-3033` executed.

srebot: vl-3033 lifecycle logged: created -> active -> removed. no escalations.

sam: relnotes updated: "Scoped runtime pin (3.6.8) for vision-lite family mitigated pin-resolution fallback observed during SDK 3.12 canary."

rita: closing thread — will reopen if customers surface regressions. :white_check_mark:
